performance_contract.note: Logical 46-stage authority boundaries may be fused into fewer product execution passes when ownership, provenance and fail-closed semantics remain exactly recoverable.

rows.design_before_code: Preserve unless a new subject-free calibration supersedes it. Do not change merely for speed.
rows.performance_role: Bounded search budget; selection is minimum passing node count.

rows.design_before_code: Never relax for compile time. Optimize algorithms around the thresholds.
rows.performance_role: Not a performance knob; quality authority.

rows.design_before_code: Preserve numerical limits; fuse/vectorize/accelerate evaluation instead.
rows.performance_role: Proof cost may be optimized, thresholds may not be weakened.
rows.quality_role: Intrinsic dynamic visual conditioning and measurable visibility.

rows.design_before_code: Benchmark convergence/latency distribution on subject-free geometry controls. Select the minimum ceilings that preserve the frozen G3 outcome distribution; do not infer optimum from 96.
rows.performance_role: Potentially large compile-time multiplier per parent patch.
rows.quality_role: Iteration ceilings determine whether the constrained refiner reaches the frozen mesh-quality target before fail-close.

rows.design_before_code: Calibrate an adaptive tessellation/refinement criterion against source curvature, deformation-field error, dynamic flip/stretch rate and compile latency. Do not choose a replacement count yet.
rows.performance_role: Code comment explicitly disables quality insertion to keep a fast iteration loop.
rows.quality_role: Controls source-owned visual primitive density/shape before deformation; exact silhouette alone does not bound deformation conditioning.

rows.design_before_code: Build subject-free seam/non-seam controls with known artist topology and skin discontinuities. Select thresholds by separation and repair efficacy; repair budget should follow convergence evidence, not an arbitrary count.
rows.performance_role: Probe angle/repair budget directly affect stress-test and recompile cost.
rows.quality_role: Determines which topology×skin discontinuities are attacked and whether a candidate passes.

rows.design_before_code: Calibrate cost-margin semantics on subject-free skeleton perturbations / known ambiguous controls. Preserve fail-closed behavior while replacing unexplained scale-sensitive constants if needed.
rows.performance_role: Requires a second exact MILP solve; still bounded for preset-sized skeletons.
rows.quality_role: Fails ambiguous topology-constrained source→target skeleton mappings.

rows.design_before_code: Measure marginal defect detection versus wall time on subject-free high-curvature motion controls. This is proof density, not output frame-rate; optimize only after measurement.
rows.performance_role: Linear multiplier on FK/LBS/intersection/visibility proof work for extra samples.
rows.quality_role: Adds samples beyond all source keyframe and contact-boundary times. Runtime plays sealed frame indices only.
